profile.summary: A software company that makes a platform for managing virtual and in-person hiring events. Its tools include event management, microsites, live chat, and candidate communication and automation. Employer talent acquisition teams use it to reach and recruit job candidates. It was acquired by Radancy in 2023.

sources.title: Radancy Acquires Brazen, Adding Award-Winning Hiring Event Capabilities to the End-to-End Radancy Talent Acquisition Cloud
